landmarks: Raised real chest plinth with six half-step rises
Red/gold back panels and circular stone crest
Perimeter roots, persistent canopy, hanging berries
deviations: 29x17x29 vanilla interpretation; real empty single chest on three-block high plinth, no loot assigned.
Six real half-step rises from feetY2 to5; five-wide stair and chest-front body route.
Paired guardians are solid stone statues with carved-pumpkin faces; no mobs or armor stands.
Two red wall banners plus terracotta hanging panels and gold trim; source image loose pots become potted mushrooms.
Complete closed roof at Y16 with canopy and roots beneath. Cutaway roof removal is display-only, no skylight or upper gallery.
guardian_faces: Carved pumpkin blocks are a vanilla facial adaptation, not stone sculpted faces.
